thread:
maria-g: Hey — working on the APAC rollout doc. Where can I find the 'Asia inference overview' dashboard (service + model health) and the Loki query we use for runtime error traces? I don't see the dashboard in my Grafana.
oz: Grafana shortlink: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/asia-inference/overview — panels: 'service_overview' and 'model_health_v2'. If you want a direct panel anchor use the dashboard params (panelId=23).
maria-g: I tried the link, hitting 403. Looks like I'm missing org permissions. @infra-bot can you check access? :frowning:
infra-bot: @maria-g ticket created (#OPS-12345) to grant org-viewer on 'asia-team'. Request submitted to infra-iam; ETA ~2h.
lee_k: For Loki, this quick query surfaces runtime/gpu errors over the last 15m: ```{app="inference", region="apac"} |= "runtime_error" | json | unwrap error_type | count_over_time(15m)``` change the window as needed.
maria-g: perfect, thanks. Is there an existing alert for error spikes or should I propose one? I only see latency/saturation alerts.
jen-sre: we don't have a runtime_error alert yet. If you can paste typical baseline numbers from that query I can draft a sensible p95 error-rate alert (and a paging rule if it looks noisy).
maria-g: will run once infra-bot confirms access. Also, any quick Jaeger link for APAC traces?
oz: Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=inference&tags[region]=apac — works once you have Grafana org access too.
infra-bot: Access updated: maria-g granted 'Viewer' on org asia-team (OPS-12345 resolved).
maria-g: confirmed — I can load the dashboard and panels now. Ran the Loki query; baseline ~0.2 errors/min, spikes up to 5/min during retries. Pasting results to #sre-evals in a bit.
jen-sre: that baseline sounds reasonable. I'll open a PR for an alert: threshold = 3 errors/min sustained for 5m with a warning at 1.5. Will link the alert rule here for review.
maria-g: thanks all — looping this into the rollout doc. :thumbsup:
oz: tagging for visibility — if you want, I can add the dashboard to the APAC runbook and include the Loki query snippet.
maria-g: please do. closing the thread. :white_check_mark:
